marta: Morning roll call — backports: merged PR #502 and #509 into release/1.2. Had to tweak the migration ordering. CI mostly green except windows-e2e flaky. Blocking: windows agent fails on db seed with timeout; can't repro locally. Today: i'll watch the canary and triage the e2e flakes. If you have bandwidth please ping.

ravi: thanks — can you paste the failing test log? i'll take #509 (packaging tweak) unless you prefer otherwise.

marta: pasted logs below:
```
ERROR seed_db.py: Timeout while waiting for redis socket
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "seed_db.py", line 42, in <module>
    seed()
  File "seed_db.py", line 28, in seed
    client.wait_for_ready(timeout=30)
TimeoutError: redis connection timed out
```

sasha: i'll rerun the windows-e2e job — sometimes the agent VM hits network flakiness. also FYI i noticed a small latency uptick in the canary (p95 ~7% higher) after last night's model tweak, i'm watching metrics now.

jon: i can pair at 11:00–12:00 if you want to debug the seed issue. i also have a follow-up PR for the packaging fix; will tag reviewers shortly.

CI-bot: Build 7853 — release/1.2 pipeline — windows-e2e: failed (rerun available) — https://ci.internal/7853

marta: @jon awesome, i'll DM calendar. @sasha thanks — please paste rerun id when it's up. Let's gate any additional backports until windows-e2e is stable. heads up: GPU canary pool at ~88% capacity, autoscale might take ~20–30m — could delay rollout.

ravi: ack — reassigning #509 to @ravi and will push the packaging patch after lunch.

sasha: kicked rerun 7853-2. linking logs when complete.

marta: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update the release board and freeze further backports until green.
